name: Compute Anatomical Statistics
summary: Computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics (thickness, surface area, volume, curvature) with mris_anatomical_stats for each parcel of the FreeSurfer aparc and an optional surface parcellation, and outputs merged CSVs.
description: Runs FreeSurfer mris_anatomical_stats per hemisphere on the subject's aparc annotation and, if provided, on a surface parcellation converted onto the FreeSurfer white surface; the per-parcel tables are merged into one CSV (also saved as cortex.csv). Use it to obtain parcel-wise cortical morphometry for group analyses. Needs the FreeSurfer subject directory; a surface parcellation also needs its left and right white surfaces.

inputs.description: Optional surface parcellation (left and right .annot files with a label table) to summarise in addition to the FreeSurfer aparc.
Optional left and right white surface meshes on which the surface parcellation is defined; required with parc_surface.
FreeSurfer subject directory; supplies surfaces and aparc annotations.

outputs.description: Per-parcel anatomical statistics CSVs and a merged CSV (merged.csv, copied to cortex.csv).
Intermediate statistics files kept for debugging.

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.message: stats computations failed somewhere. please check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log and raw derivatives.
